name: usb_device_dfu_fixed
description: USB_Device/DFU_Standalone with MAX_STATIC_ALLOC_SIZE corrected to 264 words (the DFU handle's 1056 bytes; its only change, see usb_device_dfu_standalone), the application area empty. The host downloads ST's own Binary/STM32F446ZE_GPIOToggle_Nucleo_144.dfu as dfu-util does with :leave. It reads the interface string's memory layout (the loader's 48 KiB read-only, the rest erasable), erases the 16 KiB sector at 0x08008000, sets the address pointer, sends the 3480 bytes in 1024-byte blocks with a DFU_GETSTATUS after each, waiting its bwPollTimeout, then sets the address again and sends the zero-length DNLOAD. On the GETSTATUS after it, the loader manifests and resets itself (NVIC_SystemReset). The flash keeps what was written, the loader finds a valid stack pointer at 0x08008000 and jumps there, and ST's GPIOToggle toggles LD1 every 100 ms. No USB device remains on the cable.
